sourceFrameSamplingConformance.editorialRepeatFlagsMeaning: source-footage-v2 false repetition flags prohibit editorial range replay, loops and holds to fill narration; they do not prohibit necessary timestamp-based CFR sampling
sourceFrameSamplingConformance.mapping: Map output presentation times to local source PTS using rational arithmetic and the pinned source-range start. Adjacent output frames may necessarily display the same input frame. Preserve elapsed-time playback and verify monotonic sampling inside each source range.
sourceFrameSamplingConformance.boundaryQuantization: Place both cuts on the common final output frame clock. Record each boundary quantization and resulting source-time discrepancy; an exact60fps grid cannot express the rational15.031683333s interval exactly. Keep each boundary error below one output frame without independent ceil-per-cut length accumulation.
